title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go, parity fixes, v1.54.0
author: Aisha Patel
ci_status: pass (build: pass, unit-tests: pass, integration-tests: pass after rerun, lint: pass)
description:
Summary: This PR unifies SDK behavior for auth/retry semantics and streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go. It also includes parity fixes where APIs drifted, and bumps SDK versions to v1.54.0. Motivation: multiple downstream teams reported inconsistencies in how auth refresh + retry interact with streaming responses (token refresh during long-lived streams, retry backoffs, and premature stream cancellations). This change consolidates the behavior into a shared design: (1) central token-refresh hook that is non-blocking for streaming reads and coordinates with the retry policy; (2) deterministic retry policy with idempotency-aware backoff; (3) ergonomic streaming client APIs that expose a single async iterator/reader across languages and a stable cancel/close contract.

What changed (high-level):
- core: Added shared auth/retry coordination layer in the SDK common runtime used by python/ts/go.
- python: Updated StreamingClient to expose __aiter__ and async context manager semantics, retry-aware token refresh hook, and improved type annotations.
- typescript: Reworked stream ReadableStream wrapper to provide unified event APIs (onData/onEnd/onError) and async iterator support; fixed race where token refresh would emit an error to user.
- go: Stabilized StreamReader interface, added CloseWithError to surface server-side errors cleanly, and aligned retry backoff parameters with other SDKs.
- parity: Fixed small API name mismatches and added compatibility shims for older user code paths.
- release: Bumped SDK package versions to v1.54.0 across the three SDKs; updated changelogs.

Compatibility notes: No breaking changes for typical usage. There are minimal ergonomic changes (preferred streaming idioms) and a compatibility shim layer so existing apps should continue to work. See release_notes for migration hints.

Testing and CI:
- Unit tests added across all SDKs for token refresh during streaming and idempotent retries.
- Integration tests run against the local mock server with long-running streams and simulated auth expiry.
- CI initially showed a flaky integration test (stream-reconnect-test) failing on macOS runners; root cause was a race in the mock server shutdown; fixed and rerun.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc (ENG-4821) linked
- [x] Unit + integration tests
- [x] Changelog entries for Python/TS/Go
- [x] Docs updated with streaming examples
- [x] Release prep (version bumps, packaging)

Deployment notes: This is a client-side SDK change only — no server deployment required. Recommend rolling out v1.54.0 to internal services (platform-app, embeddings-pipeline) with a canary for 48 hours to validate long-lived stream behavior.

References: Linear ENG-4821, ENG-4899; SUP-3142 (support case).

release_notes:
- SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) v1.54.0: unified auth + retry behavior for streaming and non-streaming calls.
- Streaming ergonomics: prefer async iterator / async context manager (Python), async iterator + event callbacks (TS), stable StreamReader with CloseWithError (Go).
- Bug fixes: race in token refresh during long-lived streams; parity fixes across SDK languages.
- No breaking changes expected; compatibility shims added.
